Class LoanValidator

java.lang.Object
lms.domain.utils.LoanValidator
public class LoanValidator extends Object
Validator for Loan entity fields.

Validates loan data including IDs, item type, and dates. Uses singleton pattern.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Majd Awwad
